concepts.why: The patient's presentation with a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, combined with the presence of CD138-positive and CD56-positive cells, and EBV-positive status, is consistent with Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

The patient's presentation with a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, combined with the presence of gains of florescence signal at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6), 8q24 (MYC), and 14q32 (IGH), is consistent with Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

The patient's presentation with a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, combined with the presence of CD138-positive and CD56-positive cells, is consistent with Peripheral T-cell lymphoma.

The patient's presentation with a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, combined with the presence of CD138-positive and CD56-positive cells, and EBV-positive status, is consistent with Nasal natural killer cell lymphoma.

The patient's presentation with a 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction, combined with the presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, is consistent with Chronic rhinosinusitis.
The patient's presentation with a 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction, is consistent with Allergic rhinitis.
The patient's presentation with a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, is consistent with Nasal polyp.
The patient's presentation with a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, combined with the presence of a soft tissue polypoid density, is consistent with Inflammatory pseudotumor.
The CD20-negative and PAX5-negative findings are consistent with plasmablastic lymphoma, a type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
